== Description ==

[[Taylor Gosiaco]] (left, tortoiseshell glasses, navy shirt, laughing, shaking hands), [[Ryan French]] (right, bald, glasses, grey Darth Vader tee, name tag “Ryan French”, smiling, shaking hands), and [[Matt Scott]] (background, black track jacket with white sleeve stripes, standing) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
